fact: Use /taskbook-setup to inspect project readiness, configure models, or request migration of legacy records.
The user can start Setup when the session is idle, with no Setup check or task workflow in progress.
Invoking /taskbook-setup without arguments returns a read-only status report.
The status report covers the current repository or worktree, available Pi models and role selections, subagent availability, the T3 binding, and Magpie tools visible to this session.

If the selected model is unavailable, the user receives the diagnostics directly. A nonempty catalog calls for selecting an available model; an empty catalog calls for registering or authenticating one.
The user can supply a specific Setup request as the command argument.
A model or reasoning-level change and an ordinary follow-up preserve the active Setup conversation.
The user chooses the storage location of the Model Configuration Table.
For a project Model Configuration Table, the user decides whether Git tracks the table.
When Setup finds a legacy .audit directory, it offers to migrate its usable facts into the Fact System.
